segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I have you down for 38 users across the QA and maintenance teams, and about 1,240 gauges in the first import. Is that still the right count?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Pretty close. We added two techs in Fort Wayne, so call it 40 seats. Gauge count is 1,260 if we include the pressure transducers that live with facilities.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it, 40 seats and 1,260 assets. The subscription at that level is $31,800 for the year, and the onboarding package is the fixed $4,500. That includes the asset import, certificate template setup, and two admin training sessions.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Finance will ask if the onboarding can be on the same invoice as the annual subscription. They hate two POs for one project.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, one invoice is fine. We can reference PO 44719 if that is the one you are using, or leave it blank until purchasing issues it.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Use 44719. Target go-live is still May 6. We need calibration reminders running before the June audits, so I don't want this sliding into late May.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Understood. If we have the signed order by April 12, we can start onboarding April 16, load the asset file that week, and do admin training on April 23 and April 25. That puts you live May 3, with a few days of buffer.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. Contract term is one year, right? We are not ready for a three-year even with a discount.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct, twelve months, May 1 through April 30 next year. Standard net 30, data export available at any time, and support included for named users.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Send the order form to me and copy Martin in purchasing. If the numbers match what you just said, I can sign tomorrow.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I'll send it this afternoon with the 40 seats, $31,800 subscription, $4,500 onboarding, PO 44719, and the May 1 start date.
